title: Anyone can set the collateral price
root_cause: setPrice has no access control; the admin-only intent is documented but not enforced.
impact: An attacker can set an arbitrary price and then borrow against inflated collateral or liquidate other users at a manipulated price.
recommendation: Store an admin address at deployment and require msg.sender == admin in setPrice.

title: Liquidations do not check position health
root_cause: liquidate only requires debt > 0. There is no check that the position is below the maintenance threshold.
impact: Any caller can liquidate any healthy position, seizing its collateral and clearing its debt.
recommendation: Require that the position's LTV is at or above the maintenance threshold before seizing collateral.

title: Rewards truncate to zero below one token
root_cause: The formula divides before multiplying: staked[user] / 1e18 * REWARD_PER_TOKEN. Integer division truncates any stake below 1e18 to zero.
impact: Users with stakes under one token earn nothing; all other users lose the fractional part of their rewards.
